messages:
Anya: Kicking off an activation lattice for catalog entry raven-9b-alpha. Canary window target US-WEST 10:30–10:50 PT. Telemetry gates: p50 latency < 120ms, p95 < 250ms, error rate < 0.5% over 5m. Initial plan: 3% canary -> 20% regional -> 100% global. Fallback ordering: raven-9b-alpha-quant -> raven-8b-stable -> local-cpu-fallback.

deploy-bot: /deploy start catalog:enable raven-9b-alpha --canary 3% --region us-west --window "2026-03-21T10:30:00-07:00/2026-03-21T10:50:00-07:00" --notes "telemetry-gates + obs stream"

Mike: Heads up — infra shows slot pressure in us-west predicted around 10:35. Recommend either hold to 10:40 or keep 3% and exclude large batch jobs.

Lia: Can we add a variant-priority rule: prefer quant variant only when memory footprint < 40GB, otherwise prefer raven-8b-stable as primary fallback? Avoids OOMs on older nodes.

Sherman: Also add an automatic rollback trigger: if p95 latency > baseline * 1.2 for 5m OR error rate > 1% for 3m, then rollback to raven-8b-stable. Make the condition explicit in deploy config.

Anya: Good catches. Update: set canary to 3% at 10:30, exclude batch nodes, add variant-priority memory threshold, and rollback triggers as Sherman suggested. We'll set a soft-hold until the first 5m telemetry snapshot is green.

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canary session id: cs-5321112222-1. Observability hook: https://obs.redwood/sessions/cs-5321112222-1. Rollback hook configured: /deploy rollback --session cs-5321112222-1 --to raven-8b-stable (auto-trigger enabled).

ops-bot: Reminder — draft release notes are at https://docs.redwood/releases/raven-9b-alpha-draft. Please call out performance improvements and the new quant variant. If there are customer-impact items, label them #urgent.

Mike: I've reduced background batch scheduling for the window and added an infra exclusion tag to keep slot headroom. Also bumped the telemetry sampling to 100% for canary traffic.

Anya: Thanks. We'll monitor the obs stream for the first 10m. If p50 or error rate drifts even slightly, we'll escalate. Ping here if you see anything unusual.

Sherman: Quick note — make sure the fallback ordering is persisted in the catalog entry (priority list) and in the routing policy so during a partial outage the system follows the expected ladder.

Anya: Confirmed. I'll push the priority list to the catalog after canary green: priority=[raven-9b-alpha-quant, raven-8b-stable, local-cpu-fallback].

deploy-bot: Canary session cs-5321112222-1 now at 6 minutes. p50=98ms, p95=210ms, error_rate=0.18%. Telemetry snapshot link: https://obs.redwood/snapshots/cs-5321112222-1/00:06

Mike: Looks healthy so far. Holding to full 20% regional after 20m observing window unless any gate trips.

Anya: Moving to monitor-only; don't escalate unless rollback triggers fire. I'll post a final enable note here after regional cutover.

Sherman: :+1:

Anya: Final note for ops — manual rollback command (if needed):
```
/deploy rollback --session cs-5321112222-1 --to raven-8b-stable --reason "latency-regress-2026-03-21"
```
Will convene rollback call only if auto-trigger doesn't stabilize.
